metadata.title: Soft Focus Glamour Portrait with Cherry

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, soft-focus profile portrait of a blonde woman with a dreamy, airbrushed quality. She is shown from the chest up, head tilted back slightly, holding a bright pinkish-red cherry to her lips with long, manicured nails. The entire image is bathed in a white, hazy glow that softens edges and reduces contrast.
coreVisualRelationships: The cherry acts as the singular point of high saturation against a muted skin tone.
The hand and face create a circular flow of movement in the upper right quadrant.
The text is nested in the negative space above the subject's nose and forehead.
coreInvariants: Extreme soft-focus/haze effect across the entire frame.
High-key lighting that bleeds into the white background.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject occupies the left and center-right, scaled to a close-up head and shoulders shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The saturated cherry and the woman's lips at the center-right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the woman's neck, moves up to the face, follows the cherry to the hand, and ends at the top-right typography.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample white space on the right side and top, blending seamlessly with the subject's skin and hair.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated peach and cream (skin and hair).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta-red (cherry and nails) and deep purple (typography).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation and high value for the majority of the frame, with a sudden spike in saturation for the focal props.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Interlocking flourishes between capital letters and following lowercase letters

composition.relationshipToImage: Placed in the brightest area of the background haze

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single font family used for both lines to maintain a cohesive, elegant look.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the formal, high-contrast calligraphic flourishes.
Offers the delicate, airy quality of 70s-era script.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, high-key profile portrait of a blonde woman with 70s glamour makeup, holding a bright red cherry to her lips. The lighting should be extremely bright and hazy, making the edges of her skin and hair blend into a white background. The cherry and her red nails should be the only saturated elements.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of right-aligned text in the top right corner using a purple formal script font. Ensure the text is small enough to not crowd the face.

verificationChecks: Is the image sufficiently hazy and soft-focus?
Is the cherry the primary color accent?
Is the text a deep purple script?
Does the background blend into white?

adjustableVariables: Exact shade of the purple text
mustRedesign: Do not use modern digital-looking sharpness
Ensure the script is not a modern 'brush' script but a classic formal one
postGenerationChecks: Check that the skin tones are smooth and airbrushed.
Verify the text is legible against the white haze.
Ensure the cherry stem is visible and delicate.
Confirm the profile view is clear despite the softness.
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus profile + high-key white haze + single saturated prop + top-right formal script overlay.
